title: Good News, Bad News
subtitle: Little specks that glimmer on the silver lining.

items.speaker: ONiON
items.text: So, who's going to fill me in on what's happened?
It is only as night falls and darkness blankets the city that they finally stop their pursuit.

items.speaker: ONiON
items.text: Alright, no need for disappointment. Don't panic. There's bound to be setbacks on the way to success, friends.

items.speaker: ONiON
items.text: But it's getting pretty late. Do you guys have any idea where you'll be staying for the night?
The crowded voices of the city seep through the canvas of a familiar tent, rising then falling as the night progresses.
In the hushed moments before slumber, Mercuria notices that Pickles hasn't yet closed his eyes.
The little dog glances up from the pages.

items.speaker: Mercuria
items.text: You're exploring some very complex ideas.

items.speaker: Mercuria
items.text: I won't make the best philosophical companion for you, I'm sorry to say.
Staring at the book under Pickles's paws, Mercuria appears to fall into a moment of thought.

items.speaker: Mercuria
items.text: I can see you prefer the world of literature to traveling our own.

items.speaker: Mercuria
items.text: If the journey starts to wear us down, we can always decide to keep going or turn back.

items.speaker: Mercuria
items.text: The truth is, the further we go, the more I feel that this task may be more than what I had envisioned.

items.speaker: Mercuria
items.text: Not every journey needs to reach its original destination.
Pickles raises his head and wags his tail.

items.speaker: "Doggie"
items.text: The puppy would like to know your thoughts.
Mercuria gazes off into the distance.

items.speaker: Mercuria
items.text: Fingers was the first person to share a bite of food with me; I was twelve, and it was my first time on the streets.

items.speaker: Mercuria
items.text: It wasn't easy, not at first. Food was always the first thing to run out.

items.speaker: Mercuria
items.text: That's why I'll always be grateful to him.
The little dog blinks his eyes.
Mercuria extends her hand to hold Pickles's paw.

items.speaker: ONiON
items.text: 5 a.m. local time, the city lay fast asleep, including the two protagonists of our story, nestled in their cozy little tent.

items.speaker: ONiON
items.text: It was then that a shadowy figure carrying a gun crept into their tent, and after only a moment, stealthily emerged, clutching a dog.

items.speaker: ONiON
items.text: The full account was pieced together following an interview by your humble journalist, ONiON, with the reports from two parties involved.

items.speaker: ONiON
items.text: And now, dear viewer, we present to you the full story.

items.speaker: ONiON
items.text: The Border Collie may be one of the smartest dog breeds in the world, but wits are no match for the power of a tranquilizer gun.

items.speaker: ONiON
items.text: Now, back to the story at hand.
Mercuria slowly opens her eyes, waking from her sleep.
Silence. The spot beside her is vacant.
All at once, a faint radiance enters her field of perception.
Silently, she follows the trail to its origin.
With the crisp sound of long grass snapping underfoot, she brushes aside the dead leaves beside a rock.
Hidden in the darkness, two small cunning eyes glint, peering at Mercuria through the crack in the rock.
